resources.description: One-call pre-trade sanity check: 'I want to long $X of SYMBOL — is now sane?' Combines live orderbook slippage at YOUR size, cross-exchange funding (carry cost), open-interest crowding, and contract security (GoPlus) into a single ok/caution/avoid verdict with a per-factor breakdown. Major ERC-20 addresses (LINK, UNI, ARB, OP, AAVE, PEPE, SHIB) resolve automatically; native assets (BTC, ETH, SOL, ...) report security n/a; an unrecognized token without token_address reads 'unknown' and caps the verdict at caution — an unscreened contract can never read 'ok'. Replaces four API integrations and the judgment layer on top of them. Raw component data embedded so you can apply your own thresholds. Stacks tokens (STX, sBTC, USDCx, stSTX, ZEST, LEO, USDh, aeUSDC, stBTC) add the Bitflow DEX venue: price impact at YOUR size from a live route quote, the pools and bins the swap crosses, and their TVL; STX and sBTC keep their CEX perp legs, DEX-only tokens report funding/OI n/a and contract risk unscreened (no GoPlus coverage on Stacks).

errors.retry: Re-request the challenge and pay again
errors.when: No payment attached (this challenge), or the attached payment failed verification: wrong amount/recipient, memo mismatch, expired, or already used (replay)

errors.retry: Fix the body and retry with a fresh payment
errors.when: Request body present but malformed (invalid JSON or wrong field types) WITH a payment header attached — checked BEFORE settlement, so the payment is never consumed. An unpaid malformed request gets the 402, not a 422

errors.retry: Back off and retry after a minute

errors.when: Payment settled on-chain but tool execution failed — the payment is marked refund_pending automatically; you are not charged for a failed call
Tool temporarily unavailable, or the gateway cannot persist the challenge (fail-closed)

size_usd.description: Intended position size in USD (drives the slippage check)

token_address.description: Optional ERC-20 contract address for the GoPlus security scan. Auto-resolved for major tokens; required for a full verdict on tokens the resolver doesn't know (otherwise security reads 'unknown' and caps the verdict at caution)

venue.description: Where the trade executes. auto (default): CEX books for majors, Bitflow for Stacks tokens, both for STX/sBTC. bitflow: price the swap on Bitflow only; cex: skip Bitflow

security.reason: ETH is a native chain asset — no token contract to screen
